# Release Evidence Requirements Checklist: Recovery and Analysis Final Closure

**Purpose**: Review whether the campaign requirements are complete, unambiguous,
and measurable enough for Stage A and Stage B release decisions.
**Created**: 2026-09-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command
based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality
review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the
requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied
for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are terminal evidence requirements defined for every recovery row, not only for the combined candidate? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK002 Are source, production-wiring, test, specification, and dependency evidence required for every roadmap finding? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK003 Are merge, post-merge ancestry, post-merge smoke, and documentation-closure requirements all specified for both stages? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, §FR-020]
- [x] CHK004 Are requirements present for generated outputs, CI, review findings, independent verification, runtime activation, browser proof, and target-device proof wherever applicable? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, §FR-016, §FR-019]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is the difference between exact candidate head, candidate merge tree, accepted merge commit, and refetched main identity explicit? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, §FR-017]
- [x] CHK006 Is “current truth” ordered clearly enough to resolve conflicts among live remote state, architecture, source/tests, feature specs, handoff, and roadmap prose? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK007 Are `DONE`, `SUPERSEDED`, `REPLACED`, `OBSOLETE`, and `BLOCKED` distinguished by objective evidence criteria? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, §FR-009]
- [x] CHK008 Is “applicable” target-runtime evidence tied to a named affected surface and release contract, instead of being left to subjective judgment? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-019]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK009 Are roadmap terminal statuses in the spec consistent with the durable-ledger terminal vocabulary in the constitution? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, Constitution §Delivery Workflow]
- [x] CHK010 Is the requirement to continue repository-solvable work consistent with the rule that an external blocker prevents completion? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, User Story 3]
- [x] CHK011 Are the single-owner, parallel-lane, generated-output, and moving-main requirements mutually consistent? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016, §FR-017]
- [x] CHK012 Are the full-suite success criteria consistent with the requirement to preserve canonical denominators and zero unexplained red? [Consistency, Spec §SC-002, §SC-005]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK013 Can `PARTIAL + REMAINING + BLOCKED = 0` be measured over a fixed, complete set of 23 finding IDs? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK014 Are every zero-false-exactness metric and its locked denominator/corpus identity defined as release evidence? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK015 Can zero actionable CodeRabbit findings be determined from a complete classification of current review threads? [Measurability, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK016 Is generated-output repeatability expressed as a measurable second-generation zero-diff condition? [Measurability, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK017 Can “zero open campaign pull requests” be distinguished from unrelated open issue-work pull requests? [Clarity, Spec §SC-007]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [x] CHK018 Are alternate flows defined for reusable, superseded, conflicting, and partially useful recovered commits? [Coverage, User Story 1]
- [x] CHK019 Are requirements specified for main moving before CI, during review, or immediately after merge? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK020 Are stale, cancelled, unsupported, timed-out, resource-limited, malformed-input, and non-converged flows all covered by fail-closed requirements? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014, §FR-015]
- [x] CHK021 Are overlap requirements defined for open pull requests, remote branches, and clean local recovery worktrees without authorizing mutation of unrelated work? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK022 Are rollback or recovery requirements documented for a protected merge whose post-merge verification fails? [Gap, Recovery Flow]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK023 Are browser and iPad performance goals quantified through existing frozen baselines or named threshold contracts? [Clarity, Spec §SC-005]
- [x] CHK024 Are hostile-input bounds, cancellation, parser/allocation/symbolic budgets, and plugin isolation specified across every affected subsystem? [Coverage, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK025 Are preservation requirements explicit for unknown facts, provenance, architecture/ABI boundaries, and runtime/static authority? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, §FR-014]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [x] CHK026 Are compiler, native oracle, external service, deployment, and physical-device dependencies named with acceptable identity evidence and non-proxy rules? [Dependency, Spec §FR-017, §FR-019]
- [x] CHK027 Is the minimum unblocking action required for each external dependency part of the blocker requirement? [Completeness, User Story 3]
- [x] CHK028 Is the assumption that focused feature specs remain authoritative validated against their current production consumers before reuse? [Assumption, Research §R-004]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
- Add review findings and document references inline.
- Independent Sol review `SPEC-REVIEW-05` passed CHK001–CHK028 against the
  exact staged 2026-09-04 specification snapshot recorded in
  `../evidence/speckit-analysis.md`. Earlier reviews exposed
  fourteen initial gaps and then status/performance-denominator ambiguities;
  the analysis loop additionally corrected ownership, pre-fanout, Stage B
  residual coverage, literal `HEX-*` IDs, and campaign-task traceability.
